# `network/routes/OsNetworkSession.js`

> **Source:** `engine/network/routes/OsNetworkSession.js`

network/routes/OsNetworkSession.js — the concrete `createSession(routeId, opts)` factory `RouteSessionManager.js` was designed to take (network plan Phase 2 note: "typically a thin wrapper around `createCollabCore({ projectId: routeId, ... })`"). This was the one piece of the plan's own architecture that was designed but never actually instantiated — Phase 2b shipped the simpler Masterserver-relay-as-direct- transport shortcut (`syncManager/SyncTransport.js`) for V1 sync, which left `ChunkTransport.js`/`CarrierRelay.js`/`DhtTransport.js` (all three built against a real peer-addressed `sendToPeer` + `CollabMeshTopology`) with no live mesh to run on. This module closes that gap.  `CollabCore.js`'s Tier 4 signaling (see `CollabSignal.js`'s header comment) already reads `os.network.masterServers` from localStorage and lazily acquires the shared pinned V2 ParticleNetworkDaemon itself. Explicit compatibility endpoints may still use the shared V1 registry. Therefore `createCollabCore({ projectId: routeId })` gets real cross-internet WebRTC signaling over the same Masterserver config the Control Panel manages.  Deliberately skips CollabCore's own peer-identity/ECDH handshake (`publicKeyRaw`/`identityProof`/`ecdhPublicKeyRaw`/`ecdhPrivateKey`, `encrypt: true`): that machinery expects raw `CollabIdentity.js` keys (ECDH keypair + identity proof), which is a different, lower-level API than the CSE-wrapped `createSigner()` this layer's identity/ signers use (see `engine/network/identity/NetworkIdentity.js`'s own header comment). This is not a security gap — every OS-level payload carried over this session already brings its own crypto/verification: `ChunkVerifier.js` content hashes, `SealedPacket.js` onion ECDH, `GroupEpoch.js` AES-GCM, signed `GroupLedger.js`/`PeerTicket.js` envelopes. CollabCore here is used purely as a WebRTC *transport* (data channels + DTLS), the same way `ChunkTransport.js` et al. were written to treat any `sendToPeer`.

## Functions

### `createOsNetworkSession(routeId, opts = {})`

**Parameters:**

- `routeId` *(string)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `[opts]` *(object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `opts.selfId` *(string)* — stable peer id for this session (e.g. `peerIdFromSigner(deviceSigner)`)
- `[opts.username]` *(string)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `[opts.routeSecret]` *(string|Uint8Array|ArrayBuffer|null)* — private 32-byte invite secret or passphrase; null marks a public room
- `[opts.relayOnly` *(boolean)* — =false]      force TURN relay so peers do not learn each other's direct address
- `[opts.onUnhandledOp]` *((peerId:string, op:object) => void)* — called when no registered op handler consumed a message
- `[opts.onPeerJoin]` *((peerId:string) => void)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `[opts.onPeerLeave]` *((peerId:string) => void)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `[opts.protocolRegistry]` *(object)* — optional injected RouteProtocolRegistry
- `[opts.logger]` *((event:object) => void)* — structured protocol diagnostics

**Returns:** session — pass to addSessionOpHandler/destroyOsNetworkSession

### `addSessionOpHandler(session, handlerFn)`

Register an op handler (e.g. `ChunkTransport.js`'s `handleChunkTransportMessage`, `CarrierRelay.js`'s `handleCarrierRelayMessage`, `DhtTransport.js`'s `handleDhtMessage` — all follow the same `(peerId, op) => boolean` "handled?" chaining pattern). Handlers are tried in registration order; the first one that returns `true` consumes the message.

**Returns:** unsubscribe function

### `registerSessionProtocol(session, descriptor)`

Register a bounded, version-aware route protocol handler.

### `sessionSendToPeer(session, peerId, data)`

This session's `sendToPeer(peerId, data)` — the exact shape ChunkTransport/CarrierRelay/DhtTransport expect.

### `sessionSendProtocol(session, peerId, data, { requireAdvertised = false } = {})`

Send a versioned protocol envelope, optionally requiring peer advertisement.

### `sessionBroadcast(session, data)`

Broadcast one application op to every connected direct mesh neighbor.

### `sessionBroadcastProtocol(session, data, { requireAdvertised = false } = {})`

Broadcast a versioned envelope only to compatible or pre-catalog peers.

### `sessionPeerIds(session)`

Connected peer IDs for routing and role coordination.

### `sessionTopologyStats(session)`

Mesh topology stats for UI display (mode, neighbor count, supernode status, gossip counters).

### `sessionPeerMetrics(session)`

Locally measured, secret-free peer transport observations.

### `sessionProtocolStatus(session)`

Protocol catalog, peer negotiation, and bounded dispatch counters.

### `destroyOsNetworkSession(session)`

Tear down a session's WebRTC connections, signaling, and topology timers.
